photography.name: Photography
photography.tagline: Supporting stills for brands, events, listings, and social campaigns.
photography.blurb: Photo sets that support video campaigns, events, and listings.
photography.longBlurb: Photography is available as a supporting service for video-led projects, events, listings, products, restaurants, and social campaigns across Broward, Fort Lauderdale, Miami, and South Florida.

included.0: Pre-shoot creative call to align the stills with the video or campaign goal
included.1: On-location capture for products, spaces, events, portraits, or social assets
included.2: Proof gallery so selects can be made without slowing down the project
included.3: Selected, retouched, color-matched final images delivered for web and social
included.4: Usage rights for the agreed scope (personal, commercial, or extended)

videography.name: Videography
videography.tagline: Brand videos, promos, and event coverage shot with the final edit in mind.
videography.blurb: Footage capture for promos, events, content days, and brand videos.
videography.longBlurb: Videography for businesses, events, creators, restaurants, real estate, and brand campaigns across South Florida. The shoot is planned around the edit, so every clip has a job.

included.0: Pre-production: concept, shot list, references, and delivery plan
included.1: On-location video capture with clean framing, movement, and usable audio when needed
included.2: Optional aerial B-roll when location, timing, and flight conditions allow
included.3: Hero edit plus platform-native cutdowns for Reels, TikTok, Shorts, or web
included.4: Two rounds of revisions and final exports sized for each platform

aerial.name: Aerial / Drone
aerial.tagline: Aerial visuals used as story footage, not generic flyover filler.
aerial.blurb: Aerial footage for properties, venues, events, and brand videos.
aerial.longBlurb: Aerial footage for real estate, venues, boats, events, and brand videos across South Florida. Every flight is scoped around location rules, safety, weather, and the final edit.

included.0: Pre-flight planning around location, weather, airspace, and project goals
included.1: Safety-first shoot plan for eligible locations and usable flight windows
included.2: Aerial movement planning for reveals, parallax, top-downs, and establishing shots
included.3: Color-matched aerial selects integrated into the final video edit
included.4: Optional pairing with ground videography or supporting photography

video-editing.name: Video Editing
video-editing.tagline: Story-first cuts, pacing, captions, color, and sound for footage that needs to perform.
video-editing.blurb: Reels, promos, recap videos, color, sound, captions, and cutdowns.
video-editing.longBlurb: Video editing is the lead offer: short-form reels, promo edits, recap videos, social cutdowns, color, sound, captions, and platform-specific exports from your footage or a new shoot.

included.0: Editorial pass: hook, structure, pacing, and story before polish work
included.1: Captions, sound design, music direction, and social-friendly rhythm
included.2: Color correction and grade matched across all selected clips
included.3: Platform-native deliverables (16:9, 9:16, 1:1) cut from the same master
included.4: Two revision rounds plus archived project files for future re-cuts

photo-editing.name: Photo Editing
photo-editing.tagline: Retouching, color, and culling for stills that support the campaign.
photo-editing.blurb: Photo culling, retouching, color, and social-ready exports.
photo-editing.longBlurb: Photo editing for supporting stills: culling, retouching, color, detail cleanup, and export sets for web, print, listings, and social campaigns.

included.0: Cull and select the keepers from your full RAW set
included.1: Color grading and consistent tone across the delivered set
included.2: Skin, sky, and detail retouching tuned to the use case
included.3: Export presets for web, print, and social in one delivery
included.4: Original RAWs returned alongside the edited masters

About.headline: A video-first audiovisual editor in Fort Lauderdale.

bio.paragraph1: Esteban Moreno is a Fort Lauderdale-based audiovisual editor who leads with video: pacing, story, color, sound, captions, and the final cut people actually watch.
bio.paragraph2: He works in English and Spanish, on set and in the edit. That bilingual range matters across Broward and Miami, where shoots and audiences often move between languages.
bio.paragraph3: The focus is video first — reels, promos, recap edits, aerial visuals, and content for businesses. Photography is available when the project needs supporting stills.

brandStatement.support: One workflow for capture and post — clear story, clean pacing, polished color, usable audio, and deliverables built for where the video will live.
